user.title: WxAlerts
user.description: Pick the Home Assistant zones to watch. Each zone is resolved to its county for NWS alerts and used as the centre of a lightning proximity ring.

error.no_locations: None of the selected zones have usable coordinates.
error.no_same_codes: No selected zone resolved to a US county, so alerts cannot be delivered. Lightning-only setups should disable NWS alerts.

abort.already_configured: WxAlerts is already configured. Adjust zones in the integration options.

init.title: WxAlerts options
init.description: Zones are re-resolved when you save. Lightning is measured as a true radius around each target, not as a map box, so the ring is never clipped on one side.

data.glm_radius_mi: Lightning radius (miles) — the outer ring, and how far the feed subscription reaches
data.glm_alert_mi: Seek-shelter distance (miles) — turns on the safety sensor
data.glm_track_persons: Also track people (every person with a GPS fix gets their own lightning device)
data.glm_backfill_url: Lightning history URL (optional) — fills the window on startup instead of ramping from zero; leave blank to derive it from the feed host

error.no_locations: None of the selected zones have usable coordinates.
